technique_name: Describe the energy cycle of the sun.
description: The energy cycle of the sun is the process by which energy is produced, transferred, and ultimately converted back into energy. In the core of the sun, nuclear fusion reactions take place, converting hydrogen atoms into helium. This releases energy in the form of gamma radiation and other forms of radiant energy, which escape the sun’s core in the form of light and heat.
